description: Unit test code for proxy configuration validation in Chromium project, including helper functions and ProxyRulesExpectation class for testing proxy rules.

classes.name: ProxyRulesExpectation
classes.description: Class representing expected proxy rules for testing purposes.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Compares actual proxy rules against expected rules, returning assertion result.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Creates an empty proxy rules expectation.

methods.name: EmptyWithBypass
methods.description: Creates an empty proxy rules expectation with specified bypass rules.

methods.name: Single
methods.description: Creates a proxy rules expectation with a single proxy.

methods.name: PerScheme
methods.description: Creates a proxy rules expectation with per-scheme proxies.

methods.name: PerSchemeWithSocks
methods.description: Creates a proxy rules expectation with per-scheme proxies including SOCKS proxy.

methods.name: PerSchemeWithBypassReversed
methods.description: Creates a per-scheme proxy rules expectation with bypass rules reversed.
